root_cause: Pre-existing source-rotation v2 ranked eligible signals by observation time and score without requiring a published date, source recency or personal-life topic; date-only recommendation dedupe could recycle a skipped source candidate.
fix: Strict dated published source <=45d old, HTTPS, eligible score and human-life topic, source-identity-aware same-day dedupe; same existing privileged RPC; no new schedulers, no provider side effects.
prevention: Require real article publication date and fresh approved topic before source selection. Keep source-specific idempotency, historical duplicate validation and ordinary publication verification.
